skill.name: template-skill
skill.description: Minimal SKILL.md template with frontmatter placeholders and an empty section for authors to add custom instructions.
skill.summary: Provides a basic starting structure for authoring a custom AI skill.
skill.author: ArtemisAI

security_audit.summary: This prompt-only template contains no executable code, network access, external commands, or sensitive data handling. No static or semantic security findings were identified.

content.user_title: Start a Custom AI Skill from a Minimal Template
content.value_statement: Creating a skill file from nothing can delay setup. This minimal template provides frontmatter placeholders and an empty section for custom instructions.
actual_capabilities: Provides a SKILL.md file with YAML frontmatter.
Declares the placeholder skill name template-skill.
Includes a placeholder description for authors to replace.
Marks where custom skill instructions should be added.
limitations: Contains no operational instructions or workflow.
Uses placeholder metadata that requires replacement.
Does not include scripts, references, examples, or tests.
Cannot perform a specialized task until customized.

use_cases.title: Create a First Skill File
use_cases.description: Use the minimal structure as a starting point before adding task-specific instructions.

use_cases.title: Standardize Initial Metadata
use_cases.description: Give contributors the same name and description fields before a team defines its workflow.

use_cases.title: Teach Skill Anatomy
use_cases.description: Demonstrate the basic frontmatter and instruction sections in a short authoring exercise.

prompt_templates.title: Review the Placeholders
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this template. List every placeholder I must replace before publication.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of the untouched template

prompt_templates.title: Draft Basic Metadata
prompt_templates.prompt: Adapt this template for [task]. Write a specific skill name and description, but keep the instruction section brief.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Complete Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Expand the template for [task]. Add trigger conditions, ordered steps, expected outputs, limitations, and two realistic examples.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Customized Skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate my completed template for unclear triggers, unsupported claims, unsafe instructions, missing edge cases, and test gaps. Recommend precise revisions.

output_examples.input: Review the untouched template for publication readiness.
output: Add task-specific instructions, expected outputs, and limitations before publication.

output_examples.input: What structure does this template provide?
output_examples.output: It provides YAML frontmatter for a name and description, followed by a marked section for custom instructions.

best_practices: Replace both placeholder metadata values before publication.
Write explicit trigger conditions and a clear ordered workflow.
Test the completed skill with realistic prompts and edge cases.
anti_patterns: Publish the template without replacing its placeholder text.
Add broad instructions that do not define inputs or expected outputs.
Claim capabilities that the completed skill does not implement.

faq.question: Is this template ready to use as a specialized skill?
faq.answer: No. It requires a real description and task-specific instructions.

faq.question: Does the template execute code?
faq.answer: No. It contains only Markdown and YAML frontmatter.

faq.question: Does the template access files or networks?
faq.answer: No file access, network access, or external commands are defined.

faq.question: Which tools does the report support?
faq.answer: The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should authors add first?
faq.answer: Replace the placeholder description, then define clear triggers, steps, outputs, and limitations.

faq.question: What license applies?
faq.answer: The report identifies the skill license as MIT.
